Question: Let \(n\) be a positive integer and \(d\) be a digit such that the value of the numeral \(\underline{32d}\) in base \(n\) equals \(263,\) and the value of the numeral \(\underline{324}\) in base \(n\) equals the value of the numeral \(\underline{11d1}\) in base six. What is \(n + d ?\)
